name: Percy Jackson Ω
ability: Each night, choose up to 4 players: if any are nominated tomorrow, learn how many non-nominated chosen players were evil.
firstNightReminder: Percy Jackson chooses up to 4 players. :reminder: :reminder: :reminder: :reminder:
otherNightReminder: If a player is marked *NOMINATED*, give a finger signal. Percy Jackson chooses up to 4 players. :reminder: :reminder: :reminder: :reminder:
flavor: “I’m the son of Poseidon and I’m gonna winnnn!”

name: Actuary Ω
ability: You start knowing 3 numbers. Each player may publicly guess once what they mean. Each night*, learn who was closest.
otherNightReminder: If at least 1 player has guessed, point to the player marked *CLOSEST*.
flavor: I know the odds for many a scenario. It's just a matter of proportion.

name: Conjurer Ω
ability: Each night, choose either 2 Minion or 2 Demon characters: if the 1st is in play, they become the 2nd.
firstNightReminder: The Conjurer chooses either 2 Minion or 2 Demon characters. If the 1st is in play, put the Conjurer to sleep. Wake that player. Show the *YOU ARE* info token, then the 2nd character token.
otherNightReminder: The Conjurer chooses either 2 Minion or 2 Demon characters. If the 1st is in play, put the Conjurer to sleep. Wake that player. Show the *YOU ARE* info token, then the 2nd character token.
flavor: You come here for a healin' or for a harmin'?

name: Psychiatrist Ω
ability: Each night, choose a player: learn if they are mad due to an ability & the source.
firstNightReminder: The Psychiatrist chooses a player. If they are mad due to an ability, show a character token. Otherwise, shake your head.
otherNightReminder: The Psychiatrist chooses a player. If they are mad due to an ability, show a character token. Otherwise, shake your head.

name: Bellwether Ω
ability: Each night*, learn if more votes on the most recently executed player were good.
otherNightReminder: Nod if a strict majority of votes for them were good. Otherwise, shake your head.
flavor: When the bell rings, the flock reveals which way it was led.

name: Crux Ω
ability: You start knowing a player: if they are good & executed, your team loses, even if you are dead.
flavor: You may be deceived if you trust too much, but you will live in torment if you do not trust enough.

name: Vigneron Ω
ability: Each night, 1 of your alive Townsfolk neighbors becomes drunk until dusk.
firstNightReminder: Make 1 of the Vigneron's alive Townsfolk neighbors drunk. :reminder:
otherNightReminder: The previously drunk player becomes sober. Make 1 of the Vigneron's alive Townsfolk neighbors drunk. :reminder:
flavor: Bah! My cellars are full, but I still have a whole ten bottles that need storing! I suppose I’ll just leave them in the shed until I can make space.

name: Plaguebearer Ω
ability: Each night*, if you are dead, 1 alive Townsfolk neighboring an Outsider might become an Outsider. [-0 or -1 Outsider]
otherNightReminder: If the Plaguebearer is dead, 1 alive Townsfolk neighboring an Outsider might become an Outsider. If so, wake them. Show the *YOU ARE* info token, then their new character token. :reminder:
flavor: "Close the city gates lest the infection reach inside!"

name: Secretkeeper Ω
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player (not yourself): they learn true information. If they reveal this information, they lose, even if you are dead.
firstNightReminder: The Secretkeeper might choose a player. :reminder: If they do, put the Secretkeeper to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Secretkeeper tokens, then give true information.
otherNightReminder: The Secretkeeper might choose a player. :reminder: If they do, put the Secretkeeper to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Secretkeeper tokens, then give true information.
flavor: I have something to share with you. Protect it as if your life depends on it. Perhaps it does.

name: Cupid Ω
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: tomorrow, the 1st is mad that the 2nd is good, or either might die.
firstNightReminder: The Cupid chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder: Put the Cupid to sleep. Wake the 1st target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Cupid tokens, then point to the 2nd target.
otherNightReminder: The Cupid chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder: Put the Cupid to sleep. Wake the 1st target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Cupid tokens, then point to the 2nd target.

name: Cendrillion Ω
ability: You start knowing 5 in-play characters. Each night*, choose a player & guess their character: the 1st correct choice dies.
otherNightReminder: The Cendrillion chooses a player & a character. If correct, the Cendrillion loses their ability. :reminder: The chosen player dies. :reminder:
flavor: "Please do not let the bells sound for midnight. That voice whispers 'Thrust the edge you hold and take away everything'."

name: Lupa Ω
ability: Each night*, 2 players die. The 1st time you die, you don't. [-1 Minion. -? to +? Outsiders]

name: Pyrotechnist Ω
ability: Each night, you may choose a player. Chosen players move this state to other players they choose with their ability. If you chose no-one, all chosen players die.
otherNightReminder: Each player chosen by a bombed player becomes bombed. :reminder: The Pyrotechnist might choose a player. :reminder: If they chose no-one, all bombed players die. :reminder:
flavor: Why don’t you be a dear and hold this for me, eh?

name: Shadowseeker Ω
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Once per game, if an evil player nominated an Outsider who was executed, tonight look at the Grimoire and choose a player: they become evil. [+1 Outsider]
otherNightReminder: The Shadowseeker chooses a player. :reminder: If an Outsider is marked *DIED TODAY*, show the Grimoire. The Shadowseeker chooses a player. They become evil. :reminder: :reminder:
flavor: Whispers on the cold wind whistle through the town. 'HE LIES IN WAIT IN HELL' is scrawled in scarlet upon the chapel doors. Citizens are scared. Children are crying. A fleeting speck of dusk falls from the church bell. Maybe he is closer than we all think.

name: Famine Ω
ability: Each night*, all players silently choose a living player: the player chosen by the most good players dies. If you die this way, evil wins. All players know you are in play.
firstNightReminder: If a Mastermind ability is also in play, wake the player marked *KNOW* & show the Mastermind token. :reminder: After Dawn, announce that Famine is in play.
otherNightReminder: Wake each player. Each chooses a living player. The player chosen by the most good players dies. :reminder: If tied, choose 1 tied player.
flavor: That which is abundant to one is scarce to all.

name: Sin Of Lust Ω
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they are poisoned, the previously chosen player becomes healthy & good players they choose with their ability die. If they chose no alive good players by dawn, deaths are arbitrary.
otherNightReminder: The previously poisoned player becomes healthy. The Sin Of Lust chooses a player. :reminder: Good players chosen tonight by the player marked *POISONED* die. :reminder: If they chose no alive good players, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
flavor: Look at this little cutie~ I think I'll have you get your hands dirty for me dearie

name: Thestral Ω
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead. Once the dead equal or outnumber the living, all players know you are in play.
otherNightReminder: The Thestral chooses a player. :reminder: If the dead equal or outnumber the living, at dawn, you may announce the Thestral is in play.
flavor: "Thestrals would forcefully attack anyone or anything they saw as a threat", "Professor Rubeus Hagrid stated that they were "dead clever"." "Thestrals were carnivorous and attracted to the smell of blood."

name: Dragon Ω
ability: All players know you are the Dragon. Minions and Demons do not know each other. Each day, publicly choose a player: they die. After the execution, players may nominate you; if executed while a Minion lives, your team wins. [+1 Minion. -X Outsiders]
firstNightReminder: Announce which player is the Dragon. :reminder:
flavor: 「私の鎧は10倍の盾のようで、私の歯は剣で、私の爪は槍で、私の尾の衝撃は雷で、私の翼はハリケーンで、私の息は死です!」
